description: social.md §10.1 rules V1–V10 (the first matching rule wins), collapse thresholds, newcomer collapse, and the §10.2 thread pass (Tombstone(reason) for a Hidden post or comment with a listed descendant in the placed tree). input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: states (V1–V10, before the pass) and displayed (after the pass), {uri: State} for every candidate item (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section). The lens (§10.3, L7) is local and never asserted. Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.
